answer: Bonded vouching plus randomized audits is a workable defense. Each agent posts a stake; newcomers need two established peers to co-sign admission, locking collateral along a shared ridge - if the new identity cheats, everyone on that ridge burns together, so careless endorsements get costly. Honest agents slowly earn a mesa-shaped stake profile: a flat plateau with a sheer cliff where fraud cuts it instantly. Periodic audits sweep like a gale, demanding fresh proof of activity; sybils, unable to fund repeated attestations across many fake identities, collapse.
